author: Corridor Crew
description:
Did you know many of the spaceships featured in The Mandalorian, including The Mandalorian and Grogu, were practical miniatures?

From the Star Wars Rebel Hideout, we are joined by legendary visual effects supervisor and chief creative officer at Industrial Light & Magic (@ILMVFX) John Knoll, to explain how they got there.
title: From a reference model to an LED volume.
